svg.aria-label: ASSIGN and MERGE are the same line, read twice
svg.text: The lifecycle — a session being merged, then collected
key "b": 2 arrivals merge · collection beats the straggler by 1 event
2 // Two of an event's five fields are CLOCKS, which ch01 established:
3 // et = event time, when it happened · pt = processing time, when we saw it
4 // v = the value being summed · key = whose activity this is
5 type Event { id, key, et, pt, v }
6 // primitive: EVENTS — the book's 9 events, in PROCESSING order (tools/stream_seed.js).
7 // EVENTS[7] = (id 7, key "b", et 50, pt 280, v 4) <- the straggler
8 // primitive: NONE — no value. Distinct from a value of 0.
9 // primitive: GAP — the session gap: silence longer than this ends a session. GAP = 120
10 // primitive: WIN — the fixed window width. WIN = 120
11 // primitive: LAG — the watermark's assumed worst-case skew. LAG = 60
12 // primitive: KEYS — the keys sessions are tracked per. KEYS = ["a", "b"]
13 // primitive: sum(ids) — total v over those event ids.
15 // primitive: append(xs, x) — xs with x added at the end. append([1], 2) = [1,2]
16 // primitive: sortByEt(es) — es in ascending event-time order.
18 // primitive: watermarkAfter(i) — highest event time through i, minus LAG.
21 type Session { start, end, ids, emitted }
23 // primitive: indexOf(e) — e's position in PROCESSING order. indexOf(EVENTS[7]) = 7
24 // primitive: contains(xs, x) — is x in xs? contains([1,2], 2) = true
26 // function: sessionsUpto(key, gap, i) — that key's sessions using only the
27 // events that have ARRIVED by processing index i. The bounds move as i grows.
35 if (last != NONE && e.et - last.end <= gap) { last.end = e.et · last.ids = append(last.ids, e.id) }
36 if (last == NONE || e.et - last.end > gap) { out = append(out, Session(e.et, e.et, [e.id], false)) }
41 // function: merged(key, gap, i) — did the event arriving at i join an EXISTING
42 // session rather than start one? That is the merge step, observed.
51 // function: collectedAt(s, gap) — the index at which the watermark passes the
52 // session end plus the gap, which is when its STATE can be released.
62 // function: needsRetraction(key, gap) — was any session collected BEFORE one of
63 // its own members arrived? That is the only thing that forces a retraction.
69 if (c != NONE && c < indexOf(EVENTS[id])) { return true }
75 // function: main() — THE CALLER: the four lifecycle steps, in order.
Step 1/0 — ASSIGN and MERGE are the same line, read twice
This one line does both jobs: if the arriving event is within `gap` of `last.end`, it is ASSIGNED to that session and the session is simultaneously MERGED — `last.end` moves. For
id 6 (et 220) the session's bound changes, which is a window boundary moving after the window existed.
